transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
I just don’t feel like doing any of the things I used to love anymore, even painting or going to my dance class. I used to be so active, but now I just can't bring myself to do any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way, and was there a specific time when you first noticed this loss of interest starting?

It’s been about four months now since it got really bad. It started after my youngest daughter moved away and they cut the arts programs at the community center about six months ago. Since then, I've just felt so empty and slowly stopped doing everything I used to love.
Have you had periods in the past where you felt this way, or is this the first time you've experienced such a low mood lasting this long?

I don't think I've ever felt like this before. I've always been very active and busy with my family and the neighborhood center, so this is all very new to me. I don't remember ever having a time where I felt so down and stopped doing everything.
Have you had any previous episodes of low mood or loss of interest that lasted for several weeks, even if they weren’t as severe as this current one?

No, I've never had any periods of low mood or lost interest in things like this before. Before these last few months, I was always a very happy person, constantly active and busy with my family and the community center. This is the first time in my life I've ever felt this way.
Besides losing interest in activities, have you also felt sad, down, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, since this started?

Yes, most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest, like my house and my heart are both hollow. I often find myself just sitting and crying over nothing in particular. It has been happening almost every day for the past four months.
Have you also noticed a significant decrease in your ability to feel pleasure from activities, even ones that used to bring you joy, regardless of whether you participate in them or not?

Yes, absolutely. When I look at my paints or my dance shoes, I just feel completely blank, like there's no point in picking them up anymore. I just end up staying on the couch because nothing brings me joy.
